description: She wears a cream-gold patterned floor-length gown with a fitted bodice, low square neckline and sleeves ending near the elbows. Dark gold geometric borders outline the neckline, cuffs and vertical front panels. A warm gold woven belt has round decorated metal fastenings and long tasselled ties. A deep reddish-brown shawl with gold embroidery hangs around her forearms and down both sides. The skirt opens slightly to show a muted rust underlayer and gold-patterned shoes. Gold drop earrings, a pendant necklace, bracelets and a ring add restrained jewelry. No headgear or armor is present.
